_readme: SMP Merchant Center feed countries (pmprint 2026-11-17, same fix as FHB 3f716239/16c0d01). Google allows at most 100 [shipping] entries per product (support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324484); the SMP feed carried 222-223 per item (measured 2026-11-17 14:2xZ on dev + prod), which would make every item 'Too many issues / Not approved' in SMP MC 5402182771. scripts/gen-merchant-feed.mjs emits shipping ONLY for codes in this list that the page also ships to, in this order, and fails the build above 100 rows. Order = US first, then SMP's live ship countries by SMP Google Search clicks 2026-10-17..2026-11-14 (GSC country dimension, sc-domain:spiritmediapublishing.com), ties by impressions, then by FHB's ranked list (src/data/merchant-feed-countries.json in FHB). KR left out: MC 'Unsupported currency' (USD prices). Checkout, JSON-LD and the page ships line still use ALL live countries; only the Google feed is capped.
